content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The critical success factor was the precise handling of HWPX (OOXML-like) internals: (1) using lxml to manage complex namespaces, (2) performing regex substitution on both .text and .tail of text nodes, and (3) crucially, stripping `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements from modified paragraphs. This prevents the 'overlapping text' rendering bug common when programmatically editing HWPX files. The strategy of iterating over the original ZIP's namelist to rebuild the archive ensured structural integrity.
